source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Use place-value positions and palindrome symmetry to solve digit clues.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Thousands digit is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Use place-value positions and palindrome symmetry to solve digit' is answered as thousands digit rather than ten-thousands digit.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Thousands digit is what produces ten-thousands digit, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Use place-value positions and palindrome symmetry to.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is ten-thousands digit because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Use place-value positions and palindrome symmetry to solve digit' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: ten-thousands digit is settled by running 'Decide whether a number is a palindrome and generate palindromes from': A palindromic number reads the same from left to right and from right to left — on the item about Use place-value positions and palindrome symmetry to.

intelligence.enrichment: In a 5-digit palindrome, the ten-thousands digit matches the units digit and the thousands digit matches the tens digit; digit clues such as double relationships fix linked place values together.
